records.budgetBasis: RES maximum total project budget, up to four years. EDU/SEED tracks have different caps and are not included in this record.

records.overlap: Related to PANDA and existing federated algorithms. Separate security guarantees, threat models and validation from already funded statistical/software aims.

records.title: NSF AI Datasets

records.officialTitle: Unlocking Dataset Value for AI-Enabled Scientific Discovery (AI Datasets)
records.conditions: US universities eligible; no PI/proposal-count caps. Single lead with subawards. Requires existing datasets and credible governance/access; new data collection is out of scope. PennCIL data rights and community partners need confirmation.

records.overlap: Potential overlap with ReCARDO harmonization, ClinEX metadata and PANDA. Separate community dataset, deliverables and costs from existing awards.
records.evidence: Current solicitation rechecked: November 4, 5 pm submitting organization local time, no LOI, no PI/count cap, one lead with subawards. Impact $2m/three years, Flagship $5m/three years, Planning $200,000. Planning duration not separately specified. Existing datasets required.
